last_source_review.scope: SteamOS jupiter-main repository package gamescope 3.17.0-1: its source recipe selects upstream tag 3.17.0 at this commit and adds the same system-sleep patch, which changes backend screen sleep but not the swapchain protocol, timing or consumed root properties. Reviewed the delta from tag 3.16.30.1 (d93118d95c786702e588973f7c4a400356897f1d, still the jupiter-3.9 stable package 3.16.30.1-2 reviewed on 2026-10-24): the v2 wire contract and server handlers against MAKO's declarations and v2 timing use, done-commit target holding, the FIFO and VRR limiters, vblank scheduling, consumed root properties, and the bundled WSI layer's Vulkan presentation-timing exposure. Repository metadata and source inspection do not identify a user's installed image.
last_source_review.result: Both swapchain interfaces advertise version 2 and the XML matches the recorded SHA-256 and every declared request/event name, opcode and wire signature, so MAKO negotiates v2 on this package. Server behavior matches MAKO's v2 assumptions: timing events only for create_swapchain_with_timing swapchains; one present_timing report per nonzero serial, with all-zero timestamps when dropped or replaced; queue completion at fence signal, then latch, then predicted pixel-out; legacy past_present_timing only for legacy-armed commits; and timing_properties with a limiter-inclusive duration, UINT64_MAX interval under VRR, resent after swapchain creation. An absolute target with no flags holds until predicted scanout reaches it, as version 1 did; VRR holds now schedule a wakeup. The release includes upstream commit 261b9be14c7f2078f49ede261b46544162502a7c's VRR limiter drift correction and counts display vblanks for fixed-refresh divisors. Consumed root properties remain present with unchanged writers. The bundled WSI layer now advertises VK_EXT_present_timing on v2 when the driver exposes VK_KHR_present_id2 and calibrated timestamps, which can enable MAKO's non-bridge Renderer-owned timing and application timing pass-through under full WSI; its stages and time domains are within MAKO's accepted set. No identified MAKO API adaptation requirement. Physical v2 bridge presentation, full WSI with VK_EXT_present_timing, gamescope_control, the complete downstream package, Steam client behavior and physical presentation were not qualified by this source review.
